name: Schlee's Gourmet Bakery and Bottle Shop

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: Observed that there was no sanitizer available and food preparation was happening (samples being made from a larger product). CORRECTED: PIC was notified and arranged for a sanitizer bucket to be delivered to the venue with test strips. Sanitizer bucket (quaternary ammonium) measured at a concentration of 400ppm, a safe and effective concentration of sanitizer. Ensure that a sanitizer for cleaning is available during use when food preparation is happening.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11(A) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (A) Cleaning agents that are used to clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-6, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation. [Pf]

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed that there was no handwashing sink despite the vendor serving samples that were generated on site. CORRECTED: PIC will handwash at the neighboring booth. Inspectors discussed preparing samples at the brick-and-mortar and pre-packaging the samples (each fully-encased) ahead of time so that handwashing would not be necessary at future temporary events. Ensure that handwashing is available for employees when food preparation will be occurring.
findings.citation_text: 5-203.11(A) Handwashing Sinks. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, at least 1 HANDWASHING SINK, a number of HANDWASHING SINKS necessary for their convenient use by EMPLOYEES in areas specified under § 5-204.11, and not fewer than the number of HANDWASHING SINKS required by LAW shall be provided. [Pf]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-702.11 Before Use After Cleaning. During the routine inspection, KS noted that the larger white powder containers were being placed into the dish machine in such a manner as to not allow the interior food contact surface to be in-contact with the sprayer nozzles/heating element of the dish machine. The heat puck thermometer gauge was only getting to a reading of around 150F within these containers. The heat sanitizing was not working within these larger containers not in-contact with the sprayer nozzles. Multiple solutions are offered in the general comments. See that smaller containers are purchased so that proper sanitizing may be completed on these containers. The idea is to find containers that can fit within the dish machine without removing the interior tray AND still be in -contact with the sprayers. 


UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be SANITIZED before use after cleaning.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.citation_text:
2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

On arrival there was to an availble CFPM in the facility.  The PIC returned to the facility shortly after the inspection began but was unable to show a copy of their CFPM certificate for verification. They showed a copy of their Food Handler Certification when they were able to log into their Serve Safe account. Education was conducted and they were instructed to maintain a copy of their CFPM certification at the facility moving forward.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.citation_text:
2-301.12(B) Cleaning Procedure. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use the following cleaning procedure in the order stated to clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms, including surrogate prosthetic devices for hands and arms: (5) Immediately follow the cleaning procedure with thorough drying using a method as specified under § 6-301.12.

An employee was observed to wash their hands and then use their bare hands to turn off the faucet, thus recontaminating their hands. Education was conducted with the PIC and they were instructed to review hand washing procedures with all staff and food handlers and enforce safe hand washing practices moving forward. Ensure that proper hand washing takes place at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.citation_text:
2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and: (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD.

A food handler was observed to don gloves without hand washing. Education was conducted with the PIC and they were instructed to review hand washing procedures and enforce safe practices within the facility moving forward. Ensure that hands are washed at all times that it is required by the code.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.citation_text:
4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

The test strips available in the facility were intended for verifying the concentration of CL based sanitizers. A quat based sanitizer was observed in use. The situation was discussed with the PIC who indicated that the need test strips were on order and should be available soon. Ensure that the test strips available in the facility are intended for use with the sanitizer used in the facility at all times. A follow up is being set for 10 days to ensure compliance.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.citation_text:
4-301.12(A) Manual Warewashing, Sink Compartment Requirements. (A) A sink with at least 3 compartments shall be provided for manually washing, rinsing, and SANITIZING EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS. 

At the pre-opening last year this facility was instructed to install a three part sink as their original plan review approved. The department head (CK) at that time allowed them to open with the understanding that they would need to replace the two part sink with a three part sink as the dish machine was to small to handle their larger pans and trays. At the time of the pre-opening and last year’s routine inspection the facility was instructed to remedy this situation prior to the 2026 routine inspection. This situation has not been corrected and is now being considered in violation. The situation was discussed with the PIC and they are instructed to correct the violation prior to the follow up. One month is being given to allow time for replacement equipment to be acquired and installed.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting.
findings.citation_text:
2-103.11(P) Person In Charge. The PERSON IN CHARGE shall ensure that: (P) FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with LAW, to the PERSON IN CHARGE, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD, as specified under 2-201.11(A).

On arrival only one employee has a signed reporting agreement. Per the PIC there are approximately 10 employees currently working at the facility. A pair of blank copies were given to the PIC at today’s inspection and they are instructed to make copies and have all food handlers sign one prior to the follow up in 10 days.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.citation_text:
4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

On arrival, test strips were not available for the sanitizers used in the facility. The PIC was unable to provide any during this inspection and a follow up is being scheduled for 10 days.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.110 Using Dressing Rooms and Lockers. (B) Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be used for the orderly storage of EMPLOYEE clothing and other possessions. 

An employee’s phone is observed on the counter next to where food preparation is taking place. Education was conducted. Phones should be stored with employee belongings or in pocket and should not be stored where contamination of foods/ food contact items can be contaminated. The phone was moved to correct.
